body: CHIEF RULING: the live dependency graph supersedes the older plan wording. C1 does not depend on P1A/P1R; it is gated only by B0R landing. After B0R is recorded landed, you may claim C1, reserve only its seven authorized paths, and implement the prepared portable film-source contract. Do not absorb parser transport, semantic/alignment production, or the later Baseball scientific slice. Until B0R lands, remain read-only as you proposed.
